create_camera: create a Camera instance with position, origin, vertical up vector, and field of view
get_cam_rotation: get the camera rotation matrix from its position, origin, and vertical up vector
translate_camera: translate the camera position and origin by a displacement vector in global or local frame
rotate_camera: rotate the camera around its origin by specified x, y, z axis angles
zoom_camera: zoom the camera in or out by a gamma factor with a minimum distance constraint
